sources.what: LIBERO-PRO, the simulator code (a fork of LIBERO; its libero_spatial/object/goal/10 files and environment code are byte-identical to LIBERO @ 8f1084e3132a39270c3a13ebe37270a43ece2a01)
LIBERO-PRO's task files (bddl_files/, init_files/ of the _swap and _task suites)

packages_not_pinned_by_the_source: mujoco (robosuite 1.4.0 accepts several; the record states the installed one)
build: clone the code at the revision; pip install -r requirements.txt; pip install -e .  (LIBERO-PRO README L145-151; torch is not needed by the simulator)
download the dataset at the revision and move bddl_files/* and init_files/* into libero/libero/bddl_files/ and libero/libero/init_files/ (README L165-172)
point the package's config (~/.libero/config.yaml or LIBERO_CONFIG_PATH) at this checkout's libero/libero folders
check: python -c "from libero.libero import benchmark; s = benchmark.get_benchmark_dict()['libero_object_task'](); print(s.n_tasks, s.get_task_init_states(0).shape)"
